# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old when first introduced  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>; Mrs. Irving  <sub>[v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mother Lavendar  <sub>[v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a little lady with snow-white hair that is thick, wavy, and arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Beneath her hair, she has a fresh, almost girlish, pink-cheeked face with dimples and big, soft, wood-brown eyes containing golden glints. She wears dainty, youthful dresses featuring frills and laces, such as a cream muslin printed with pale roses.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022)_

## Personality

Lavendar is a romantic, imaginative, and sweet-tempered woman who retains a youthful spirit and dislikes feeling old. She frequently indulges in daydreaming and play-acting, such as inventing imaginary guests for tea or holding conversations with her woods' echoes. While generally warm, sweet, and hospitable, she admits to having a proud and sulky streak when deeply hurt.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## Goals

- To keep her heart and life young despite her age  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>

## History

Lavendar lived a secluded, quiet life at Echo Lodge, a small stone house in Grafton built by her father. Following a youthful quarrel with her fiancé Stephen Irving, the engagement was broken and Stephen moved to the United States. Lavendar remained single in her isolated home, keeping company with her young maidservant, Charlotta the Fourth, and her imaginative 'dream people.' Anne Shirley and Diana Barry stumbled upon Echo Lodge by accident while trying to find their way to West Grafton and bonded instantly with her. Anne eventually introduced Stephen's son, Paul Irving, to Lavendar, forging a sweet friendship between them. When Stephen returned to Prince Edward Island years later, Anne helped facilitate a meeting between the estranged lovers. Lavendar and Stephen reconciled and were married in the garden of Echo Lodge the following August. Following their wedding, they moved to Boston with Paul and Charlotta the Fourth, returning to spend their summers at Echo Lodge.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 c28 P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P2](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Her father named her after the lavender scent on the sheets when he first visited her mother's home in East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Her mother died ten years before Anne Shirley met her  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Was engaged to Stephen Irving twenty-five years before their eventual reunion, but broke it off after a petty quarrel  <sub>[v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Spent ten years employing a series of teenage girls named Charlotta to live with her for board and clothes  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> I do hate to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake?  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

> I always like to do things as well as possible, and since an old maid I had to be I was determined to be a very nice one.  <sub>[v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015)</sub>

> I’m really a very happy, contented little person in spite of my broken heart.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
